label: UniFi Dream Machine
description: UniFi Dream Machine (UDM) - 1x 1G RJ45 WAN + 4x 1G RJ45 LAN, no PoE. WiFi 5; 26 W max.
notes: Port census from the vendor datasheet, 'Networking interface': (4) LAN GbE RJ45 ports, (1) WAN GbE RJ45 port; no SFP and no PoE on this model. Max. power consumption 26 W. The tech-spec page (https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/udm, 608,032 B, read 2026-11-18) prints no networking-interface row, so the datasheet is the source of the counts.
